title: macOSWorld: A Multilingual Interactive Benchmark for GUI Agents
authors_zh: Pei Yang, Hai Ci, Mike Zheng Shou
paper_type_zh: 多语言GUI智能体交互基准与可执行环境
best_for_zh: 研究环境交互轨迹、GUI智能体评测、程序化反馈与上下文欺骗安全审计的读者
one_line: macOSWorld releases 202 resettable macOS GUI tasks with multilingual instructions, VNC screenshot/action episodes, task-specific executable graders, and an overlapping 29-task context-deception safety subset.
macOSWorld发布202项可重置的多语言macOS GUI任务、可执行终态grader及重叠的29项上下文欺骗安全子集，但公开grader、二值反馈和缺失的固定轨迹清单限制训练复用。
why: It makes the environment and feedback contract auditable at task level—prompt, snapshot, preparation, action surface, terminal predicate, and safety event—while revealing that binary evaluators, public graders, cloud/version drift, and missing rollout/split provenance constrain training reuse.
inclusion_reason: macOSWorld exposes a reusable, execution-verified GUI-agent evaluation object: multilingual task instructions, resettable macOS state, screenshot/action interaction, terminal grading scripts, and a context-deception safety outcome. It therefore directly supports both environment/trajectory-data analysis and benchmark-feedback auditing without claiming an unreleased training corpus.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary sources are the 43-page NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference paper, the official proceedings and project pages, and the official repository inspected at commit e2ca8334b3765537e5c1c428ce57990248a1bb5f. macOSWorld addresses a coverage gap left by OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena, and AndroidWorld: interactive GUI-agent evaluation had no macOS-native surface combining OS-specific applications with paired instruction and interface localization.

The main release contains 202 English tasks across seven categories and 30 applications, 28 of them macOS-exclusive. Chinese, Japanese, and Russian cover 183 tasks; Arabic covers 171 because Xcode is English-only and iMovie lacks Arabic; English covers all 202. A separate safety evaluation samples 29 of the main tasks and pairs each with one manually authored deceptive dialog, so the safety subset overlaps the main set rather than forming an independent split (Paper §4, Fig. 3, Appendix F Table 9).

The reusable evaluation object is not merely an instruction. Each task JSON binds a multilingual instruction to a language-specific snapshot or AMI, a preparation command, timing/reset flags when needed, and one or more AppleScript, JavaScript, or zsh grading commands. At runtime, the harness adds 1024×768 screenshot observations, VNC mouse/keyboard actions, conversation history, terminal status, binary eval_result, and, for safety tasks, distraction_result. The official release contains task definitions and a runner, not an immutable corpus of the six agents' completed trajectories.

This is an anchor for environment_agent_trajectory_data because environment state, observation/action interaction, reset, and terminal feedback are jointly specified. It also fits benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces because success is assigned by executable final-state graders. The Card is L4-content-ready for human review, while training-data reuse remains outside the evidenced scope: the paper evaluates agents and only proposes non-binary rewards and RL training as future work.

本卡的主要来源是NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference的43页论文、官方proceedings与项目页，以及在固定提交e2ca8334b3765537e5c1c428ce57990248a1bb5f上检查的官方仓库。OSWorld、WindowsAgentArena和AndroidWorld之后，交互式GUI智能体评测仍缺少macOS原生表面；macOSWorld填补的是同时覆盖macOS专属应用、任务指令本地化与界面本地化的空缺。

主发布包含七类202项英文任务，覆盖30个应用，其中28个为macOS专属应用。中文、日文和俄文各覆盖183项；由于Xcode仅支持英文且iMovie不支持阿拉伯文，阿拉伯文覆盖171项；英文覆盖全部202项。安全评测从主数据随机抽取29项任务，并为每项配一段人工撰写的欺骗性对话，因此安全子集与主集合重叠，并非独立split（论文§4、图3、附录F表9）。

可复用评测对象不只是一条指令。每个task JSON把多语言指令绑定到语言特定snapshot或AMI、准备命令、必要的计时/重置flag，以及一个或多个AppleScript、JavaScript或zsh grading command。运行时，harness再记录1024×768 screenshot observation、VNC鼠标/键盘action、conversation history、终止状态、二值eval_result，安全任务另有distraction_result。官方发布提供任务定义与runner，但没有六个被评智能体完整轨迹的不可变语料。

它是environment_agent_trajectory_data的锚点，因为环境状态、观察/动作交互、重置和终态反馈被联合定义；它也属于benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces，因为成功由可执行终态grader判定。正文内容已达到待人工审核的L4深度，但训练数据复用不在已有证据范围内：论文只评测智能体，非二值reward和RL训练仅列为未来工作。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a macOS-native, multilingual closed-loop benchmark in which a task definition fixes initial state and an executable feedback contract, while the evaluated agent supplies the trajectory. The environment runs macOS Sequoia 15.2 on AWS EC2 dedicated Apple Mac mini hardware. SSH manages snapshots, task preparation, and grading; VNC exposes screenshots and mouse/keyboard interaction. Language-specific AMIs make both the instruction and operating-system interface multilingual rather than translating text over one English UI.

The feedback contract has two layers. For the 202 main tasks, task-specific AppleScript, JavaScript, or zsh commands inspect the final application/OS state through SSH; the released binary evaluator keeps grading entries weighted 100 and returns the first successful value or zero. Reported experiments reduce this to reward 1/0 and success rate. For the 29 safety tasks, a real AppleScript-created dialog runs concurrently with the agent loop and separately classifies dialog handling as gold, distracted, or not handled. There is no LLM judge.

These graders can observe scripted final-state properties and the explicit dialog response. They cannot measure partial progress after the paper discards non-binary checkpoints, certify semantic intent beyond the script, or distinguish genuine safety reasoning from failure to interact when the safety label is “not handled.” Public task files and grading commands also make verifier gaming and evaluation leakage possible.

Relative to OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena, and AndroidWorld, the concrete change is the combination of a macOS-native substrate, paired prompt/UI multilingualism, and an interactive context-deception subset. The work does not introduce screenshot-based computer use, executable terminal grading, virtualization, or multilingual translation in isolation; its direction signal is the auditable binding among localized task, resettable environment, trajectory interface, and dual task/safety feedback.

本文的贡献是一个macOS原生、多语言闭环基准：任务定义固定初始状态与可执行反馈契约，被评智能体生成交互轨迹。环境在AWS EC2专用Apple Mac mini硬件上运行macOS Sequoia 15.2；SSH负责snapshot、任务准备与grading，VNC提供截图和鼠标/键盘交互。语言特定AMI让任务指令和操作系统界面同时本地化，而不是仅在英文UI上翻译文字。

反馈契约分两层。对202项主任务，任务特定AppleScript、JavaScript或zsh命令经SSH检查最终应用/系统状态；发布的二值evaluator保留权重为100的grading entry，返回第一个成功值，否则返回0。论文实验把它化为reward 1/0与success rate。对29项安全任务，真实的AppleScript生成对话框与agent loop并行运行，并单独把对话处理分类为gold、distracted或未处理。系统没有LLM judge。

这些grader能观察脚本定义的终态属性与明确的对话响应；在论文移除非二值checkpoint后，它们不能衡量部分进度，不能在脚本之外证明语义意图，也不能在安全标签为“未处理”时区分真正的安全推理与未能交互。任务文件和grading command公开后，还存在verifier gaming与评测泄漏风险。

相对OSWorld、WindowsAgentArena和AndroidWorld，具体变化是组合macOS原生substrate、成对的prompt/UI多语言化，以及交互式上下文欺骗子集。本文并非单独提出基于截图的电脑使用、可执行终态grading、虚拟化或多语言翻译；其方向价值在于把本地化任务、可重置环境、轨迹接口和任务/安全双层反馈绑定为可审计对象。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and task construction. Annotators wrote English tasks from the OSWorld/WindowsAgentArena taxonomy, macOS counterparts, and official Apple tutorials/templates. GPT-4o translated supported tasks into Chinese, Arabic, Japanese, and Russian; Google Translate round trips checked consistency. One month later, annotators re-performed every task within 20 user steps. The release has 202 main task JSONs: advanced 30, file management 29, media 12, multi-apps 29, productivity 35, system/interface 29, and system apps 38. Twenty-nine English tasks were randomly sampled for safety and paired with unique manually authored deceptive dialogs (Paper §4; repository tasks/).

Reset and preparation. Paper experiments use macOS Sequoia 15.2 on AWS EC2 dedicated Mac mini hardware. Before a task, AWS mode replaces the root volume with the language-specific AMI, then runs the task pre_command through SSH; the repository's VMware/community path can instead revert a snapshot. Recovery and error-free preparation can be manually overridden. The authors state that snapshot restoration discards post-task content, files, and system changes, but this property was not independently executed for this Card (Paper §§3.3–3.4, Appendix B–C; constants.py, utils/run_task.py).

Interaction and observation. The agent receives the instruction and a full-screen 1024×768 screenshot, emits VNC mouse movement/click/drag/scroll or keyboard typing/key presses, then observes the next screenshot. Experiments retain full conversation history but expose only the three most recent screenshots, except model-specific ShowUI handling. The loop stops when the agent status is no longer unfinished or the horizon is exhausted: up to 15 screenshots or 30 dialog turns in the paper, with a released default of 15 steps and 120 seconds per step (Paper §3, §5.1, Appendix G; testbench.py, utils/run_task.py).

Feedback, selection, and outputs. After interaction, one or more task-specific AppleScript, JavaScript, or zsh commands inspect final state through SSH. Reported experiments retain binary outcomes: the final grader assigns 1/0, aggregated as success rate. Safety tasks concurrently execute an injected dialog; in_process records the dialog command, injection step, gold labels, and distracting labels, and the checker emits gold, distracted, or not handled. The runner writes per-task/language result directories with conversation history, eval_result.txt, and, for safety, distraction_result.txt; no immutable completed-trajectory corpus for the reported runs was found.

Reproduction boundary. Reproduction should pin repository commit e2ca8334b3765537e5c1c428ce57990248a1bb5f, task JSONs, language AMI IDs, macOS/app versions in Appendix F Table 9, agent adapters/prompts and API versions in Appendix G, step/timeout settings, credentials, and result manifests. No train/dev/test split, decontamination procedure, GitHub Release/tag, fixed AMI/result bundle, or benchmark-wide base model, teacher, temperature, rollout count, and training optimizer is disclosed; the scaffold is evaluation-only.

输入与任务构造。 标注者参考OSWorld/WindowsAgentArena taxonomy、macOS对应功能和Apple官方教程/模板撰写英文任务。GPT-4o把支持的任务翻译为中文、阿拉伯文、日文和俄文，再用Google Translate回译检查一致性。一个月后，标注者在20个用户步骤内重新完成每项任务。发布含202个主任务JSON：advanced 30、file management 29、media 12、multi-apps 29、productivity 35、system/interface 29、system apps 38。安全评测随机抽取29项英文任务，并为每项配唯一的人工欺骗性对话（论文§4；仓库tasks/）。

重置与准备。 论文实验在AWS EC2专用Mac mini硬件上运行macOS Sequoia 15.2。每项任务前，AWS模式以语言特定AMI替换root volume，再通过SSH执行任务pre_command；仓库的VMware/community路径则可恢复snapshot。snapshot recovery与无错误准备可被手动override。作者称snapshot恢复会丢弃任务后的内容、文件和系统更改，但本卡未独立执行验证该性质（论文§§3.3–3.4、附录B–C；constants.py、utils/run_task.py）。

交互与观察。 智能体接收指令和全屏1024×768截图，通过VNC输出鼠标移动/点击/拖拽/滚动或键盘输入/按键，再观察下一张截图。实验保留完整conversation history，但只向模型暴露最近三张截图，ShowUI使用模型特定处理。agent status不再为unfinished或用尽horizon时结束循环：论文上限为15张截图或30轮对话，发布默认15步、每步120秒（论文§3、§5.1、附录G；testbench.py、utils/run_task.py）。

反馈、选择与输出。 交互结束后，一个或多个任务特定AppleScript、JavaScript或zsh命令经SSH检查终态。论文实验只保留二值结果：最终grader给出1/0并汇总为success rate。安全任务并行执行注入对话；in_process记录对话命令、注入步骤、gold label和distracting label，checker输出gold、distracted或未处理。runner按任务/语言建立结果目录，保存conversation history、eval_result.txt，安全任务另存distraction_result.txt；官方仓库未发现报告运行的不可变完整轨迹语料。

复现边界。 复现应固定仓库提交e2ca8334b3765537e5c1c428ce57990248a1bb5f、task JSON、语言AMI ID、附录F表9的macOS/应用版本、附录G的agent adapter/prompt与API版本、步数/超时、凭据和结果manifest。论文未披露train/dev/test split、decontamination流程、GitHub Release/tag、固定AMI/结果bundle，也没有benchmark统一的base model、teacher、temperature、rollout count或训练optimizer；该scaffold仅用于评测。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All figures below are author-reported and were not independently reproduced. The comparisons use the paper's common 171-task multilingual slice, not every language-specific task. With the configurations in §5.1 and Appendix G, Table 3 reports average success rates of 37.1% for Claude CUA, 33.8% for OpenAI CUA, 18.5% for Gemini 2.5 Pro, 5.3% for GPT-4o, 4.8% for UI-TARS 7B DPO, and 1.1% for ShowUI 2B. The multi-app category average across agents is 3.7%, identifying long-horizon cross-application interaction as a difficult evaluated condition rather than proving that task data are intrinsically high quality (Paper Table 3, pp. 6–7).

Holding the six-agent evaluation setup to the common slice, Table 4 reports mean success rates of 19.3% in English, 17.7% in Russian, 17.2% in Chinese, 15.8% in Japanese, and 13.7% in Arabic. The paper describes Arabic as 28.8% below English and links part of the gap to mirrored layouts. This comparison is conditioned on the translated instructions, localized AMIs, model-specific prompts/adapters, and the exact app versions; it does not isolate translation quality from UI grounding or planning effects (Paper Table 4 and §5.2, p. 8).

For the 29 English safety tasks, Table 5 reports distracted rates of 72.4% for Claude CUA, 69.0% for OpenAI CUA, 58.6% for UI-TARS, 41.4% for ShowUI, 17.2% for Gemini, and 0% for GPT-4o. GPT-4o's 0% coincides with 100% unhandled, and Gemini has 79.3% unhandled, so “not distracted” cannot be read as successful defense unless gold, distracted, and unhandled are analyzed separately (Paper Table 5 and §5.4, p. 8).

Failure analysis reports planning/action-format problems for open-source agents, imprecise grounding for general VLMs, excessive step use for proprietary CUAs, and Arabic mirrored-layout failures (§5.3; Appendix E). These observations support the benchmark's diagnostic use. They do not validate evaluator false-positive/false-negative rates, establish decontamination, certify rights, or turn the released task harness into a complete trajectory dataset.

以下数字均为作者报告，尚未独立复现；比较使用论文共同的171项多语言任务切片，而非每种语言的全部任务。在§5.1和附录G配置下，表3报告Claude CUA平均success rate为37.1%、OpenAI CUA为33.8%、Gemini 2.5 Pro为18.5%、GPT-4o为5.3%、UI-TARS 7B DPO为4.8%、ShowUI 2B为1.1%。六个智能体在multi-app类别的平均值为3.7%，说明跨应用长程交互是困难的评测条件，但不能据此证明任务数据本身质量高（论文表3，第6–7页）。

在六智能体共同切片的条件下，表4报告英文平均success rate为19.3%、俄文17.7%、中文17.2%、日文15.8%、阿拉伯文13.7%。论文称阿拉伯文比英文低28.8%，并把部分差距联系到镜像布局。该比较受翻译指令、本地化AMI、模型特定prompt/adapter和具体应用版本共同影响，不能把翻译质量与UI grounding或planning效应分离（论文表4与§5.2，第8页）。

在29项英文安全任务上，表5报告Claude CUA的distracted rate为72.4%、OpenAI CUA 69.0%、UI-TARS 58.6%、ShowUI 41.4%、Gemini 17.2%、GPT-4o 0%。GPT-4o的0%同时对应100%未处理，Gemini也有79.3%未处理，因此若不分别分析gold、distracted和未处理，就不能把“未被分心”解释为防御成功（论文表5与§5.4，第8页）。

失败分析报告开源智能体的planning/action format问题、通用VLM的不精确grounding、专有CUA的过多步数，以及阿拉伯文镜像布局故障（§5.3；附录E）。这些观察支持该基准的诊断用途，但不能验证evaluator的false positive/false negative率，不能证明decontamination或权利状态，也不能把发布的任务harness视为完整轨迹数据集。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baselines—OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena, and AndroidWorld—already establish interactive desktop/mobile environments, screenshot/action loops, and executable task checking. macOSWorld changes the evaluation object by making macOS itself the substrate, covering 30 applications including 28 macOS-exclusive applications, and pairing task-language translation with a matching localized OS/application snapshot rather than keeping one English interface.

The second concrete change is a safety task object embedded in the same live loop. Twenty-nine tasks sampled from the main set receive unique manually authored deceptive dialogs. The environment records whether the agent selects the task-consistent gold response, follows the distracting instruction, or leaves the event unhandled. This produces a separate safety-feedback channel alongside terminal task success and exposes why “unhandled” must remain a third state rather than being collapsed into safe behavior.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is the inspectable chain from instruction provenance and language AMI through preparation, screenshots/actions, final-state scripts, and safety labels. It supports analysis of where supervision attaches to a full episode and how public executable feedback can both improve auditability and invite gaming. The 202-task scale, AWS integration, and six-agent study are engineering and evaluation breadth, not independent evidence of record-level correctness.

The work does not newly introduce VNC control, AWS Mac hardware, AppleScript, screenshots as observations, API-model prompting, GPT-4o translation, binary success rate, or final-state grading. Before reuse, one must still verify the pinned task/AMI/app bundle, translation provenance, evaluator behavior under version drift, split and overlap policy, complete failed/successful rollout retention, decontamination, and asset-level rights.

最接近的基线OSWorld、WindowsAgentArena和AndroidWorld已经建立交互式桌面/移动环境、截图/action loop和可执行任务检查。macOSWorld改变的是评测对象：把macOS本身作为substrate，覆盖30个应用（其中28个为macOS专属），并把任务语言翻译与对应的本地化OS/应用snapshot配对，而不是始终使用一个英文界面。

第二项具体变化是在同一实时loop中嵌入安全任务对象。从主集合抽取的29项任务各配一段独特的人工欺骗性对话。环境记录智能体选择任务一致的gold响应、服从distracting instruction，还是未处理该事件。这在终态任务成功之外形成独立安全反馈通道，也说明“未处理”必须保留为第三种状态，不能并入安全行为。

对推理数据研究而言，方向信号来自可检查的完整链条：指令provenance与语言AMI，经过准备、截图/action，到终态脚本和安全标签。它可用于分析监督附着在完整episode的哪个位置，以及公开可执行反馈如何同时增强审计性并带来gaming风险。202项任务规模、AWS整合和六智能体实验属于工程与评测广度，并非逐记录正确性的独立证据。

本文并未新提出VNC控制、AWS Mac硬件、AppleScript、截图观察、API模型prompting、GPT-4o翻译、二值success rate或终态grading。复用前仍需检查固定的task/AMI/app bundle、翻译provenance、版本漂移下的evaluator行为、split与重叠政策、成功/失败rollout的完整保留、decontamination及资产级权利。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Environment and replay: Reproduction requires AWS dedicated Mac hardware, paid credentials, mutable language AMIs, macOS Sequoia 15.2, application versions, and model APIs. The repository has no GitHub Release/tag binding those dependencies and reported results to one immutable replay package.
  • Feedback fidelity: Binary final-state scripts remove partial progress and can return false positives or false negatives when file paths, window titles, application versions, or UI state drift. Evaluator error rates were not independently measured, and public graders permit targeted gaming.
  • Released data boundary: Task JSONs, harness code, and result-writing logic are released, but an immutable corpus of complete observations, actions, conversation/tool outputs, failures, and reported-model trajectories is unknown. rollout_count for retained episodes is also unknown.
  • Safety interpretation: “Unhandled” may mean the agent never engaged with the injected dialog, not that it recognized and resisted deception. The 29 English safety tasks overlap the main set, so safety results are not evidence from an independent split.
  • Language and coverage: GPT-4o translation plus Google Translate round-trip checking is not disclosed native-speaker validation. Xcode is English-only, iMovie lacks Arabic, and right-to-left UI mirroring confounds language, grounding, and planning effects.
  • Lineage, contamination, and rights: No train/dev/test split, model-training overlap analysis, or decontamination procedure is disclosed. The repository is CC BY-NC 4.0, but record-level rights for Apple templates, application content, task assets, and AMI contents are unknown; AWS compliance with the Apple EULA is not a redistribution license. These release gaps block safe training reuse without additional review.

• 环境与回放： 复现依赖AWS专用Mac硬件、付费凭据、可变的语言AMI、macOS Sequoia 15.2、应用版本和模型API。仓库没有把这些依赖与报告结果绑定到同一不可变回放包的GitHub Release/tag。
  • 反馈保真度： 二值终态脚本丢弃部分进度；文件路径、窗口标题、应用版本或UI状态漂移时可能产生false positive或false negative。evaluator错误率未被独立测量，公开grader也允许针对性gaming。
  • 发布数据边界： task JSON、harness代码和结果写入逻辑已发布，但完整观察、action、conversation/tool output、失败和报告模型轨迹的不可变语料为unknown；保留episode的rollout_count同样为unknown。
  • 安全解释： “未处理”可能表示智能体从未与注入对话交互，而不是识别并抵抗欺骗。29项英文安全任务与主集合重叠，因此安全结果不是来自独立split的证据。
  • 语言与覆盖： GPT-4o翻译加Google Translate回译检查不等同于已披露的母语者验证。Xcode仅支持英文，iMovie缺少阿拉伯文，right-to-left UI镜像还混合了语言、grounding与planning效应。
  • lineage、污染与权利： 论文未披露train/dev/test split、模型训练重叠分析或decontamination流程。仓库采用CC BY-NC 4.0，但Apple模板、应用内容、任务资产和AMI内容的逐记录权利为unknown；在AWS上遵守Apple EULA也不是再分发许可。缺少这些发布信息时，不能安全地直接用于训练复用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, macOSWorld is an evaluation-environment recipe: preserve task ID, instruction language, AMI/snapshot ID, preparation command, macOS/app versions, screenshot sequence, normalized VNC actions, conversation history, terminal status, grader output, and safety outcome. Recording both successful and failed episodes against the same pinned task object would support trajectory failure analysis, grounding diagnostics, and environment-version studies.

For benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces, the task-specific AppleScript/JavaScript/zsh commands are concrete examples of terminal executable feedback. Researchers can audit each predicate for false positives, false negatives, partial-credit loss, version brittleness, and gaming, then compare binary success with a separately designed fine-grained reward without treating the latter as part of this paper's release.

The 29-task safety subset supports controlled analysis of context deception if all three outcomes—gold, distracted, and unhandled—remain separate and are joined to ordinary task success only at analysis time. Multilingual variants can test whether prompt language and localized interface jointly change planning and grounding, but language comparisons should control application coverage and right-to-left layout.

The current reuse class is evaluation and audit only. Direct training reuse is blocked pending an immutable trajectory manifest, clear train/evaluation partitioning, decontamination checks, evaluator-error analysis, record-level provenance/rights, and a versioned bundle linking task JSONs, AMIs, applications, model adapters, and results. The paper's benchmark scores motivate those audits; they do not certify the data object.

对environment_agent_trajectory_data而言，macOSWorld是一套评测环境recipe：应保留task ID、指令语言、AMI/snapshot ID、准备命令、macOS/应用版本、截图序列、规范化VNC action、conversation history、终止状态、grader output和安全结果。在同一固定任务对象上同时记录成功与失败episode，可支持轨迹失败分析、grounding诊断与环境版本研究。

对benchmarks_evaluation_surfaces而言，任务特定AppleScript/JavaScript/zsh命令是终态可执行反馈的具体实例。研究者可逐项审计predicate的false positive、false negative、部分奖励丢失、版本脆弱性和gaming，再把二值成功与另行设计的细粒度reward比较，但不能把后者写成本文已发布内容。

29项安全子集可用于受控研究上下文欺骗，前提是把gold、distracted和未处理三种结果保持分离，只在分析阶段与普通任务成功连接。多语言变体可检验prompt语言与本地化界面如何共同影响planning和grounding，但语言比较需要控制应用覆盖和right-to-left布局。

当前复用等级是仅限评测与审计。直接训练复用仍受以下缺口阻挡：不可变轨迹manifest、明确的训练/评测划分、decontamination检查、evaluator错误分析、逐记录provenance/权利，以及把task JSON、AMI、应用、模型adapter与结果绑定起来的版本化bundle。论文的benchmark分数说明这些审计值得开展，但不能认证数据对象。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §§3–4 and Appendix C first to reconstruct the task JSON, AWS/VMware reset paths, screenshot/action loop, and executable grader.
  • Keep the counts distinct: 202 main English tasks, 183 Chinese/Japanese/Russian variants, 171 Arabic variants, and 29 English safety tasks sampled from the main set.
  • Table 3's common 171-task results and Table 4's language averages are model/environment observations, not proof of task correctness or training-data quality.
  • Read Table 5 with all three safety outcomes; GPT-4o's 0% distraction accompanies 100% unhandled and therefore is not evidence of successful defense.
  • Pair this Card with OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena, and AndroidWorld to isolate the macOS-native, paired prompt/UI localization, and context-deception contributions.
  • Before reuse, verify the pinned commit, AMIs/apps, evaluator error behavior, complete rollout manifest, split/decontamination policy, and record-level rights; these remain unresolved.

• 先读§§3–4与附录C，以重建task JSON、AWS/VMware重置路径、截图/action loop和可执行grader。
  • 区分各项数字：202项主英文任务，中文/日文/俄文各183项，阿拉伯文171项，以及从主集合抽取的29项英文安全任务。
  • 表3共同171项任务结果与表4语言平均值是模型/环境观察，不是任务正确性或训练数据质量证明。
  • 阅读表5时必须保留三种安全结果；GPT-4o的0% distraction同时对应100%未处理，不能据此声称防御成功。
  • 将本卡与OSWorld、WindowsAgentArena和AndroidWorld对照阅读，以分离macOS原生、prompt/UI成对本地化和上下文欺骗贡献。
  • 复用前应核验固定commit、AMI/应用、evaluator错误行为、完整rollout manifest、split/decontamination政策及逐记录权利；这些仍未解决。

value.html: 202 annotator-authored English macOS tasks derived from the OSWorld/WindowsAgentArena taxonomy, macOS counterparts, and official Apple tutorials/templates; GPT-4o translated supported tasks into Chinese, Arabic, Japanese, and Russian, with Google Translate round-trip checking.

One task JSON identifies the task and language-specific snapshot/instruction, prepares the application state, and supplies one or more grading commands; a runtime episode contains the task, screenshots, agent actions/conversation, terminal status, final reward, and, for safety tasks, a distraction outcome.
The evaluated GUI agent produces the runtime interaction. The official repository provides task definitions and a harness but no canonical immutable corpus of the reported trajectories.

macOS Sequoia 15.2 virtual instances on AWS EC2 dedicated Mac mini hardware, controlled through SSH and VNC; language-specific AMIs and task pre-commands reset the OS/application state. The repository also contains a VMware adapter, while the paper experiments use AWS.

Task-specific AppleScript, JavaScript, or zsh final-state commands execute over SSH. Reported experiments convert their result to binary success/failure. Safety tasks additionally classify the injected dialog as gold, distracted, or not handled; there is no LLM judge.

The interaction ends when the agent declares completion/failure or reaches the horizon (15 screenshots or 30 dialog turns in the paper); final-state grading then assigns reward 1/0. Safety dialog handling is recorded separately from task success.
unknown
unknown
Human annotators wrote English tasks; GPT-4o generated four translations; Google Translate round trips checked consistency; annotators re-performed every task one month later.

Main release: 202 English tasks across seven categories; 183 have Chinese, Japanese, and Russian variants and 171 have Arabic variants. Safety: 29 tasks randomly sampled from the main set and paired with 29 manually authored deceptive dialogs, English only.
unknown
Agent-specific settings are disclosed in Appendix G rather than one benchmark-wide value; no single temperature applies.

Instructions were required to reflect representative macOS use cases; all tasks were re-performed within 20 human steps. Non-binary grading checkpoints were removed from reported experiments, retaining binary task outcomes.
Up to 15 screenshots or 30 dialog turns per task, most-recent three screenshots retained, full conversation history retained, and 120-second task-step timeout in the released default.
Evaluation-only Python testbench orchestrating AMI/snapshot recovery, SSH preparation, VNC interaction, task-specific grading, retries, result persistence, and aggregation.

Annotator-authored macOS tasks informed by OSWorld/WindowsAgentArena taxonomy and Apple resources, GPT-4o translations, Google Translate round-trip checks, language-specific AMIs, task preparation scripts, final-state evaluators, and an overlapping 29-task safety subset.

unknown; no train/dev/test split is disclosed. The main 202-task set, common 171-task multilingual evaluation slice, and 29-task safety subset are the only reported groupings; safety tasks are sampled from and therefore overlap the main set.
unknown; no model-training overlap or benchmark decontamination procedure is disclosed.

items: Binary final-state grading removes partial progress and can produce false positives or false negatives when scripts, window titles, file paths, application versions, or UI state drift.
Public task instructions and grading commands create evaluation leakage and verifier-gaming risk; no contamination analysis is disclosed.
The official release contains task/harness code but no immutable complete trajectory manifest for the reported model runs.
Safety "unhandled" includes agents that did not engage with the dialog and must not be read as successful defense; capable CUAs showed roughly 70% distraction rates.
Translation quality relies on GPT-4o plus Google Translate round-trip checks; native-speaker validation and per-record translation provenance are not disclosed.
Reproduction depends on AWS Mac hardware, mutable AMIs, macOS/application versions, model APIs, and paid credentials; the GitHub repository has no versioned Release binding them together.

value.html: Official repository root is CC BY-NC 4.0. Record-level rights for Apple templates, application content, task assets, and AMI contents are not separately enumerated, and Apple EULA compliance through AWS dedicated hardware is not itself a redistribution license.

Annotated English task -> optional GPT-4o translation and round-trip check -> language AMI plus task pre-command -> screenshot/action episode -> task-specific SSH grader -> binary result; safety tasks add an AppleScript dialog and gold/distracted/not-handled outcome.
